per_round_suite_score.note: Rounds that attempted fewer tasks than the fullest round are still in progress and are excluded; rounds that attempted every task but scored fewer are kept and flagged.

plugin.definition: Bernoulli(p_hat) per task: noise only, the rate taken as exact.

posterior.definition: p drawn from Jeffreys Beta(k+0.5, n-k+0.5) then Bernoulli(p): includes that p itself is only estimated.

estimate.definition: Trials resampled within each task: the precision of this experiment's own estimate, not the spread of a future run.

definition.mdd95_pp: A gap between two single runs smaller than this is within what noise alone produces 95% of the time when the two are in fact equal.
definition.mdd95_power80_pp: The gap needed for a single-run comparison to come out significant 80% of the time.

detectable_difference.basis: rerun.plugin (the measured tasks are the whole suite)

adjudicability.note: A verdict with no retained observation and no verifier reason cannot be re-examined by anyone. Such runs count in every rate above; they are excluded from any false-positive / false-negative analysis.

drift.note: Median completion tokens per round; per-step mean where steps[] exists, run total otherwise. A step here is the signature of the serving endpoint changing; the screen says where to look, not that it happened. Fewer than 4 rounds: no screen.

leave_one_out.method: Each round dropped in turn; every figure recomputed on what is left.
